source: DEMO DATA. Illustrative rules for local development only. They are not the insurer's underwriting guidelines. Replace with the approved rule set.

rules.title: BMI above 35
rules.rationale: Demo rule: a BMI above 35 is referred to the underwriter.

rules.title: HbA1c 6.5% or higher
rules.rationale: Demo rule: an HbA1c of 6.5% or higher is referred to the underwriter.

rules.title: Systolic blood pressure above 160 mmHg
rules.rationale: Demo rule: a systolic reading above 160 mmHg is referred to the underwriter.

rules.title: Tobacco use declared
rules.rationale: Demo rule: declared tobacco use is highlighted for the underwriter.

rules.title: HIV screening reactive
rules.rationale: Demo rule: a reactive screening result is referred to the underwriter.

rules.title: Laboratory values flagged by the report
rules.rationale: Demo rule: three or more report-flagged lab values are highlighted for review.

rules.title: Proposed sum assured above INR 2 crore
rules.rationale: Demo rule: high sums assured need financial underwriting.

rules.title: Total cover more than 20 times annual income
rules.rationale: Demo rule: proposed plus existing cover above 20x stated annual income is referred.

rules.title: Identity documents do not match the KYC form
rules.rationale: Demo rule: an identity mismatch must be resolved before a decision.

risk_scoring.method: Sum of points for triggered rules, capped at the scale maximum.

bands.label: Low
bands.interpretation: No significant adverse demo rule triggered.

bands.label: Moderate
bands.interpretation: Some adverse demo rules triggered; review the evidence.

bands.label: High
bands.interpretation: Several or severe demo rules triggered; detailed review needed.
